overlay.title: Voice conversation
overlay.permission_denied: Microphone access is required for voice. Enable it in your system settings and try again.
overlay.use_prompt: What you say will be added to the message box when you're done.

failure.connection_failed: Voice couldn't connect right now. Text messaging still works as usual.

unavailable.no_voice_runtime: This agent has no voice runtime bound yet. Ask a workspace admin to configure one — text messaging still works.
unavailable.instance_disabled: Voice is turned off for this agent's voice runtime. Text messaging still works as usual.
unavailable.instance_not_active: The voice runtime for this agent isn't active right now. Try again later, or keep using text.
unavailable.capability_mismatch: This agent's model doesn't support voice conversations. Text messaging still works as usual.
unavailable.credential_missing: Voice isn't fully configured for this agent (missing credentials). A workspace admin needs to finish setup.
unavailable.credential_invalid: The voice credentials for this agent are invalid or expired. A workspace admin needs to update them.
